title: UFL MVP set to work out for 49ers. His coach thinks he's at 'NFL standard'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: UFL MVP set to work out for 49ers. His coach thinks he's at 'NFL standard'
sources.description: Reigning UFL MVP Jack Plummer is reportedly set to work out for the 49ers and Dolphins. Here's what coach Anthony Becht thinks of his NFL potential.
